g.text: Embedding and snapshot launchers share one publisher.
User import consumes the last compatible snapshot.
Dry-run approval binds the profile destination.
All jobs use shared.jobruntime.JobProgress for periodic reporting.
CSV readers and input records live in shared.csv.
History ports and adapters live in shared.readhistory.
recommenderagent does not depend on the jobs.
Catalogue code has no dependency on recommenderagent.
read books / fill missing or rebuild vectors
read existing IDs and dense vectors
read descriptions / fill missing or rebuild summaries
create/fill books matched by payload id
approved write: update usable vector sides
preserve absent, unmapped or cancelled-out sides
Migration copies existing data; it generates no embeddings or summaries.
Six non-web launchers; snapshot launcher needs no enable flag.
Jobs never run during ordinary recommendation-server startup.
Run maintenance writers separately against a stable catalogue.
